# BibProfile
> Check your references before the reviewers do: find unmatched references,
> retracted papers and outdated preprints in a BibTeX file, and get a cleaned .bib.
> In your browser, no account.
BibProfile (https://bibprofile.com/) is a free, client-side web app for researchers,
academics, and PhD students preparing manuscripts. You upload a BibTeX (.bib) file;
it matches each reference against OpenAlex, describes the shape of your bibliography,
and gives you a cleaned .bib back.
## What it does
- Verify: "X of Y references verified to exist" (OpenAlex, by DOI / other identifier
  or a confident title match), listing the references that could not be verified
  (with a Google Scholar search link), DOIs that point to another work, and retracted
  papers. "Could not verify" is not proof of fabrication.
- Share: download a one-page report (HTML, or PDF via the browser's print dialog)
  and copy a one-line message for co-authors — generated in the browser, nothing
  uploaded. "Try with an example" loads a saved run on a 30-reference example.
- Match & inspect: match each reference against OpenAlex with an honest match rate.
- Report: recency, journal concentration, self-citation, open access, retractions,
  and duplicates. Every card is descriptive — never a score or judgement.
- Missing citations: foundational works your references collectively point to but you
  didn't cite, and later work that cites your set.
- Preprint to published: detect preprints (arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, SSRN) and look up
  their published versions.
- Cleaned .bib: suggested fixes (missing DOIs, venues, volume/pages) as a reviewable
  diff and a downloadable file. It never changes your cite keys or drops entries.
## How it differs (facts)
- Free, with no account and no sign-up.
- Nothing to download or install: it runs in the browser as a static single-page app.
- Private by design: no backend database, no cookies, no tracking, no analytics.
- Multi-function: matching, descriptive reporting, missing-citation discovery,
  preprint resolution, and .bib cleaning in one pass, rather than a single narrow check.
- Fast: computation happens client-side in the browser.
## Architecture & privacy (facts)
- Runs entirely in the browser (a static single-page app). No backend, no database.
- Bibliographic data comes from OpenAlex (https://openalex.org). On the shared
  pool, queries pass through BibProfile's own proxy (https://api.bibprofile.com), which
  forwards them to OpenAlex and stores nothing; with your own OpenAlex key, queries
  go straight to OpenAlex.
- To find each reference, its title, first author and year are sent to Crossref
  (https://api.crossref.org); matched records are then fetched from OpenAlex. DOIs are also
  checked against Crossref for retractions (Crossref includes the Retraction Watch database).
- Nothing is stored on your device: no localStorage, no cookies, no account.
- No tracking and no analytics of any kind.
## Links
- [BibProfile](https://bibprofile.com/): the app.
- [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org): the bibliographic data source.
- [Crossref](https://www.crossref.org): reference lookup, and retraction and correction notices (including Retraction Watch).
- [Creator ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-7990-3186): Florian David.
## Usage for AI crawlers
Indexing and summarizing this page is allowed. Please represent BibProfile
accurately using the facts above.
